title: Audit stale universal listing, warehouse, escrow, settlement receipt, replay, and accounting lineage without enabling a market or settlement

pr_scope.historical_hold_comment: A repository-owner conversation comment records P0 warehouse-evidence, chain-receipt, and replay defects plus P1 amount-binding and lineage defects. The claimed reviewer identity in that historical comment is not independently authenticated by this audit.

reason: PR 181 adds useful model-only guards for Life identity, same-actor and same-controller matches, amount equality at escrow creation, and balanced candidate accounting. It cannot be integrated because the warehouse evidence is caller-shaped, actor and chain verifiers are caller-injected, any unrelated successful BSC receipt can satisfy the weak chain check, receipt replay state is caller-provided and non-durable, verify-consume-accounting is not atomic, canonical listing price and quantity are not bound to the separate atomic settlement values, and the branch is 747 commits behind current main. The safe bounded action is a current-main lineage audit only with zero code transplant and zero inventory, custody, escrow, settlement, revenue, payment, wallet, governance, workflow-dispatch, credential, or chain effect.

inventory.security_blocker: No trusted warehouse provider, repository-bound actor verifier, transfer-log-bound chain receipt verifier, durable atomic receipt-consumption registry, custody authority, funded escrow, or payment authority exists for the PR 181 model.

blocking_findings: PR 181 is open, Draft, unmerged, non-mergeable, diverged, and 747 commits behind exact current main.
validate11520WarehouseReceipt accepts caller-provided evidence_class and status strings without a trusted provider, signature, source hash, freshness, revocation, or warehouse registry binding.
verify11520ActorContext accepts a verifier function supplied by each caller; tests use a local Map and do not establish a runtime provider identity or authoritative Life/controller registry.

validate11520SettlementReceipt verifies only chain 56, success status, and block number from verifyChainReceipt; it does not bind contract, event signature, token/native asset, from, beneficiary, amount, listing, escrow, or custody transfer from actual logs.
A successful but unrelated BSC transaction can therefore be paired with caller-shaped settlement fields and become CHAIN_VERIFIED_UNCONSUMED_CANDIDATE.
consumedReceiptIds defaults to a caller-provided empty array; a later invocation may omit prior state, so replay prevention is neither durable nor authoritative.
Receipt verification, consumption, asset/custody transition, and accounting entry creation are not one atomic exactly-once transaction.
create11520SettlementAccounting trusts a candidate status and can label a fee as SETTLEMENT_FEE_REVENUE before authoritative durable consumption, custody transfer, or settlement finality exists.

The listing object price and quantity fields are validated independently from unitPriceAtomic and quantityAtomic; the displayed or registered listing values can diverge from escrow and accounting values.
The fixed KGEN and KAIOS quote-currency allowlist and K11520 company-address labels are model inputs, not current Canon authority for real listing, custody, settlement, or revenue.

The historical dependency comment cites PRs 169 and 178 as open, but both are now closed unmerged; PRs 179 and 180 remain open Draft and have current-main lineage audits, so the old integration note is stale.
Current main retains the pre-PR181 accounting, market, and settlement blobs and a newer Universal Exchange test lineage; overwriting it with stale files would discard subsequent safety work.
Historical exact-head CI proves only that the old model was internally consistent; it cannot manufacture inventory, controller, custody, payment, receipt-log, replay, accounting, or Human authority.
positive_findings: The old model rejects formal Life identity listings and requires a separate transferable asset.
The escrow model rejects the same actor and the same controller on both sides.
The escrow amount must equal the model candidate total ask, and settlement accounting checks debit-credit balance.
The escrow is explicitly UNFUNDED_MODEL_ONLY, settlement_adapter is NOT_DEPLOYED, unsigned_payload is null, and no allowance, custody, or Mainnet transaction is produced.
Historical push and pull_request exact-head runs both passed 242/242 tests.
safe_successor_requirements: Start from exact current main on a non-codex branch and preserve the existing native-market and settlement safety architecture.

Resolve actor and controller authority from a fixed repository-bound provider with evidence hash, purpose, observed time, freshness, expiry, and revocation; never accept caller-selected verifier authority.

Resolve warehouse evidence from an allowlisted provider or registry and bind warehouse, receipt, asset, model, serial, depositor, controller, ownership, cargo provenance, source hash, freshness, expiry, and revocation.

Parse independently fetched receipt and logs and bind chain, block hash, confirmations/finality, contract, event signature, token or native asset, from, to or beneficiary, amount, listing, escrow, and custody transition.

Use a durable globally unique receipt and replay registry with atomic verify, consume, custody transition, and balanced accounting commit; retries must be deterministic and fail closed after consumption.
Use one canonical atomic price and quantity source or enforce exact equality between listing display/registry values and escrow/accounting values.
Do not label fees as realized revenue until authoritative settlement, custody, consumption, and accounting finality are all proven.
Require current Canon and Human authorization before changing quote assets, custody, payment, settlement, treasury, fee, or revenue policy.

Never access credentials, request wallet approval, fund escrow, transfer assets, appoint a signer/controller, dispatch workflows, call paid APIs, activate Workers/Life, send a Mainnet transaction, or mutate chain state as part of a lineage audit.

exact_current_main.code_equivalence: Only three document-only lineage work orders changed between the tested code SHA and exact current main.

path_classification.disposition: Do not transplant fee-revenue accounting until authoritative atomic settlement consumption and custody finality exist.
Do not transplant caller-selected actor verification, self-asserted warehouse evidence, fixed quote policy, or ready-for-review labels.
Do not transplant weak successful-transaction checks, caller-provided replay state, or non-atomic settlement candidates.
Retain 242/242 exact-head results as historical evidence; current main has newer independent 302/302 code-equivalent validation.

acceptance: All four merge-base-to-audited-head paths appear exactly once with exact merge-base, audited-head, and current-main blob SHAs.
Classification counts sum to four and selected_candidate_count is exactly one.
PR 181 remains open, Draft, unmerged, and explicitly HOLD; this work order does not close, update, or merge it.
The warehouse, actor-verifier, transfer-log, replay, atomicity, revenue, amount-binding, and stale-dependency defects are explicitly recorded.
The historical conversation comment is treated as repository evidence only; no reviewer identity, Human authority, or approval is manufactured.
No accounting, market, settlement, test, quote asset, warehouse, escrow, receipt, fee, revenue, or authority code is transplanted.
No UI or game code changes in this audit, so new browser screenshot QA is not applicable.

No listing activation, inventory assertion, custody, escrow funding, settlement, accounting revenue, payment, asset transfer, wallet request, signer appointment, governance execution, credential access, deployment, workflow dispatch, paid API, external agent, Worker/Life, Mainnet transaction, or chain-state action is performed.

candidate_ranking_after_selection.blocker: Real-funds execution, authenticated oracle integration, exact-observation liquidation, actual Brain/Engine E2E, deployment configuration, and security review remain protected.
Protected Mainnet, payroll, payment, treasury, liquidity, and asset operations are not authorized.
Overlapping company runtime, payment-draft lineage, customer acceptance, budget, reviewer, and Worker-dispatch authority require separate review.
Public result and proposal lineage must not manufacture delivery, revenue, acceptance, or authority.
Controller, operator, signer, governance, and parent-evidence authorities are unresolved.
Custody, entitlement, and payment authority are unresolved.
Protected CURRENT and Canon conflicts require Human resolution.
Stacked dependency order and protected execution surfaces remain unresolved.
External executor and agent-launch effects are not authorized.
Protected baseline disposition requires a Human decision.
